requirement: P0 is a local evidence desk: local session, bounded corpus, one question, bounded answer, validated source/chunk context.
acceptance_boundary: Product promise stays separate from semantic correctness and milestone approval.
anti_qa_check: Owner/anti-QA confirms scope and role boundary before acceptance.

requirement: Bootstrap exposes local runtime, corpus readiness, active profile, and allowed conditions.
acceptance_boundary: BOOTING/OFFLINE/DEGRADED/READY_EMPTY/READY are not run statuses.
anti_qa_check: Check readiness and unavailable/error paths separately.

requirement: User can add an accepted local source and see import/index result and snapshot context.
acceptance_boundary: Import is bounded/additive and does not create a run.
anti_qa_check: Check valid, empty/unsupported, oversized, and retry paths.

requirement: User submits a non-blank question and receives one persisted run with the request paired to it.
acceptance_boundary: Condition/provider are explicit and capability-controlled; no silent fallback.
anti_qa_check: Check pending, validation failure, and same-question retry semantics.

requirement: Terminal run states remain distinct: COMPLETE, PARTIAL, NO_EVIDENCE, FAILED, and unknown.
acceptance_boundary: Execution status is not a quality score; API/inspection errors are not NO_EVIDENCE.
anti_qa_check: Exercise each status and verify honest copy/recovery.

requirement: Valid canonical citations open source/chunk context and return to the originating answer; invalid locators do not link.
acceptance_boundary: Preserve source/chunk provenance and do not fabricate offsets/highlights.
anti_qa_check: Check valid, invalid, missing, and lookup-error paths.

requirement: Recent runs are a flat immutable list; opening a run does not replay or mutate it.
acceptance_boundary: History loading/error is distinct from empty history; retry creates a new run only when asking again.
anti_qa_check: Check list failure, detail 404, reopen, and New question.

requirement: P/N/O semantics remain unchanged and planning evidence is separate from answer evidence.
acceptance_boundary: P is planning retrieval, N exact duplicate normalization, O overlap-aware allocation; no new module/control.
anti_qa_check: Reviewer checks planning IDs never render as answer citations.

requirement: A/B/C and milestone condition availability remain capability-controlled.
acceptance_boundary: M0=A only; M1=A/B/C; M2=A/B/C/C-P/C-N/C-O; current M0/M1/M2 status is unchanged.
anti_qa_check: Compare returned allowed_conditions/profile with UI choices.

requirement: Inference remains local-only and FakeProvider remains wiring/test-only.
acceptance_boundary: No cloud/public provider or external worker tool; no semantic claim from FakeProvider.
anti_qa_check: Inspect provider labels and negative fallback behavior.

requirement: Backend/frontend payloads preserve identity, provenance, trace, metrics, terminal status, and additive fields.
acceptance_boundary: Missing metrics remain unavailable; unknown fields/statuses are not rewritten.
anti_qa_check: Check a persisted RunRecord against the contract and raw trace.

requirement: Error envelope and scoped recovery keep request/API/resource failure separate from semantic result.
acceptance_boundary: Use message/detail/error safely; preserve HTTP status and retryability.
anti_qa_check: Check validation, 404, local-model, import, and internal failure paths.

requirement: Local registration, login, session restore, and logout use hashed credentials/tokens and never grant client-side roles.
acceptance_boundary: USER/ADMIN and session expiry remain server-authorized; no hosted identity.
anti_qa_check: Check invalid, duplicate, restore, logout, and unauthorized paths.

requirement: Settings and minimal admin surfaces expose only safe local runtime/auth/run metadata.
acceptance_boundary: Regular users cannot self-elevate and secrets/hashes are never returned.
anti_qa_check: Check 401/403, safe payload, and read-only behavior.

requirement: Owner-scoped conversations persist ordered USER/ASSISTANT turns and keep each turn linked to its immutable run.
acceptance_boundary: Conversation identity is separate from RunRecord; unauthorized IDs never cross users.
anti_qa_check: Create two local users and verify isolation, reopen, and run linkage.

requirement: A single bounded deterministic context builder excludes the current message and caps recent history.
acceptance_boundary: Current request remains authoritative; empty context is valid and no cross-conversation memory exists.
anti_qa_check: Check cap/truncation/current-message exclusion and topic switch.

requirement: Conversation history is separate from retrieved KB evidence and never becomes a citation target.
acceptance_boundary: Only canonical source/chunk IDs are linkable answer evidence.
anti_qa_check: Inspect run envelope/events and citation resolver.

requirement: Normal mode is answer-first; Research/Demo is progressive disclosure only.
acceptance_boundary: Mode changes do not mutate run/config/corpus/condition/provider/model.
anti_qa_check: Toggle mode around an active run and compare identity fields.

requirement: P0 anti-QA handoff includes owner review, implementation contract checks, live/static evidence separation, and raw-record retention.
acceptance_boundary: Handoff is pending review; it cannot self-approve P0 or promote M0/M1/M2.
anti_qa_check: Return failures with the affected run/error/trace and exact requirement ID.

requirement: No dataset/gold, reports/runs, research method, or milestone state is changed by this product delta.
acceptance_boundary: P0 code/docs may change only within the approved product slice; preserve Last Known Good and failed evidence.
anti_qa_check: Audit changed paths before handoff; no research artifact mutation or push.
